title: action send: data
description: Post a message in scope.room (or scope.thread). The connector splits text longer than limits.message_max_chars and renders unsupported elements as text.

mention.description: Address the line to this user (connector picks the platform's convention).

relay.description: (1.1) Present when a bridge hub relays a person's line. The connector renders {name} from author.name only, never from author.display; never re-splits a presplit part (one over its limit is refused relay_refused, details.code too_long); and never logs or remembers an otr line.

msg_id.description: The line's id at the hub.

otr.description: Off the record: never written to the connector's logs or memory.

hops.description: 0 = native line; 1 = already bridged once (never relayed further).

render.description: Render style (open), e.g. prefix, masquerade, bot.

presplit.description: The hub split the line: text fits one platform line; the connector does not split.

deadline_ms.description: Give up (error timeout) if the line cannot be sent within this time of receipt.

reply_to_remote.description: Platform message id to reply to natively (features.reply_refs).
